prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 19 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1499; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of lumbar strain and localized low back pain radiating to the paraspinal muscles. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the collision, and the presenting symptoms align well with that mechanism. Over the course of 19 visits, treatment followed a conventional and expected progression, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching guidance. Visit frequency decreased steadily as functional capacity and pain levels improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the patient's history or available records. Billing for services rendered reflects single, appropriate charges for each documented intervention, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At discharge, the patient was improving with a good prognosis for full recovery, and a home exercise program was provided for ongoing self-management.
